sanskrit_verse:
प्रमाणनिश्चितो यस् तु व्यवहारः स उच्यते /
वाक्छलानुत्तरत्वेन द्वितीयः परिकीर्तितः // BrhS_1,9.5
transliteration: pramāṇaniścito yas tu vyavahāraḥ sa ucyate / vākchalānuttaratvena dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ // BrhS_1,9.5
sph_interpretive_translation: That conduct which is definitively established by valid means of knowledge is declared as rightful action; that which follows from verbal equivocation or failure to respond is designated as secondary.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives exclusively from pramāṇa (valid cognition)
Causation is determined through śabda and artha alignment
Capacity-based responsibility arises only upon clear pramāṇa
Restoration logic requires alignment with ontological truth
Consciousness alignment is prerequisite for lawful behavior
executable_legal_axioms: IF vyavahāra IS NOT pramāṇa-established THEN it SHALL BE classified AS secondary and subject to clarification protocols
IF vākchala OR anuttara EXISTS THEN automatic referral TO pramāṇa verification system IS REQUIRED
NO legal consequence SHALL BE enforced WITHOUT pramāṇa confirmation
ALL judicial determinations MUST PRIORITIZE consciousness clarity OVER linguistic ambiguity
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any dispute involving linguistic ambiguity or non-response must be referred back to pramāṇa-based validation prior to final determination. Responsibility thresholds are only activated when pramāṇa is unambiguously established.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa serves as the sole pramāṇa for nyāya. Causal sequence (anupūrvaśaḥ) is traced back to cognitive clarity. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of pramāṇa-access. There is no punitive consequence—only realignment to pramāṇa-established dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa-realignment process for all parties involved
Deploy śabda-vyavastha module to resolve linguistic ambiguities
Assign anuttara-resolution pathway to restore capacity for truthful response
Reintegrate consciousness clarity through meditative jurisprudential protocol
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is established: pramāṇa alone determines lawful conduct. All else is secondary until clarified. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
